name: Surena's Choker
summary: In Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder seeks the bloodstone choker he gave his former apprentice, Surena Caledon. She fled with Erlan Drudgemoor to join the Defias Brotherhood, and Gakin now sends aspiring acolytes to take it back by force.

sections.title: A Master's Lost Investment
sections.body:
Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder once trained Surena Caledon in the dark arts. He saw promise in her youthful charm and magical talent, and gave her a valuable bloodstone choker to aid her studies. But Surena left her training and fled with Erlan Drudgemoor, a rogue aligned with the Defias Brotherhood.

Gakin will not let a traitor keep such a potent artifact. Now he sends initiates seeking mastery over the void to find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch and reclaim the choker by force. Their deed will prove where their loyalty lies.

faq.q: Why does Gakin the Darkbinder want Surena's Choker back?
aliases: why does gakin want the choker
faq.answer: Gakin gave Surena the bloodstone choker while she was his apprentice. She abandoned her studies and fled with a member of the Defias Brotherhood. Gakin will not let a traitor keep a prized artifact of dark magic.

Surena Caledon is a former apprentice warlock who showed natural talent under Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind. She turned from her tutor and fled with Erlan Drudgemoor, hiding among the Defias outlaws in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can the choker be found?
faq.answer: Surena Caledon carries the choker at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest, where she is holed up among the Defias bandits.

faq.q: What is the choker used for after it is retrieved?
aliases: what does gakin do with the choker
why do warlocks need the choker
faq.answer: Taking back the choker proves an acolyte's ruthlessness and loyalty to Gakin the Darkbinder. He has not said what he will do with it. He laments Surena's wasted talent and hopes his investment in a new student brings different results.

angles.text: As a Human or Gnome warlock, retrieving Surena Caledon’s choker is a first trial. It shows that sentiment has no place in the pursuit of demonic power.
